# foundry_prompt_agent (Resource)

Manages a prompt agent, which runs a model deployment against a set of instructions. Changing the definition publishes a new agent version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "foundry_prompt_agent" "support" {
  name         = "support-agent"
  description  = "Answers product support questions."
  model        = "gpt-4.1"
  instructions = "You are a concise support agent. Answer in at most three sentences."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model` (String) Name of the model deployment that backs the agent.
- `name` (String) Agent name. Changing this forces a new agent to be created.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the agent version.
- `instructions` (String) System instructions for the agent.

### Read-Only

- `agent_guid` (String) Service-assigned unique identifier for the agent.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID of the agent instance identity.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the current agent version, in `name:version` form.
- `principal_id` (String) Principal ID of the agent instance identity.
- `version` (String) Current agent version number.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Prompt agents are imported using the agent name.
terraform import foundry_prompt_agent.support support-agent
```
